morphology.pattern_note: 外来人名，整词作为独立单位记忆，不按马来语词缀拆分。规范书写首字母大写；所列为常见英语读音，实际称呼以本人发音为准。参见 [Cambridge：Catherine 发音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/pronunciation/english/catherine)。没有可确认的马来语派生词族，因此 word_family 为空。

senses.zh_definition: 凯瑟琳；通常用作女性名字的外来专有名词。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, usually feminine, used in English, French, and other languages.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama perempuan, yang digunakan dalam bahasa Inggeris, bahasa Perancis dan bahasa lain.
senses.nuances: 属于 kata nama khas，不是表示一般事物的马来语普通名词。此处马来文释义为编辑说明，资料包没有提供 DBP 释义；status 按指定格式保留，不代表 DBP 已收录或认证。以下为自然称呼组合，并非有独立词义的固定搭配。

messages.speaker: Catherine (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku kat depan kedai ni. Nak masuk sekarang?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah sampai dan berada di hadapan kedai ini. Mahukah kamu masuk sekarang?

etymology.historical_story: Catherine belongs to the European name family associated with Greek Aikaterine, whose original meaning remains uncertain. Medieval devotion to Saint Catherine helped spread the name across languages. Its familiar association with Greek katharos, meaning pure, developed later and should not be treated as its established original meaning. See the [Dictionary of Medieval Names](https://dmnes.org/name/Katherine).
